claims.formal_statement:
import Mathlib

open scoped BigOperators

namespace ChecksumCore

theorem represented_mass_le_one {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (m : ι → ℝ)
    {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (hMass : ∑ i ∈ s, m i ≤ L) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, m i / L ≤ 1 := by
  rw [← Finset.sum_div]
  exact (div_le_one hL).2 hMass

theorem weighted_first_moment {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (m : ι → ℝ) (z : ι → ℂ) {L P : ℝ}
    (hL : 0 < L) (hP : 0 < P) (hm : ∀ i ∈ s, 1 ≤ m i) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, (m i / L) • ((L / (P * m i)) • z i) =
      ∑ i ∈ s, (1 / P) • z i := by
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  have hmi : m i ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (hm i hi))
  have h : m i / L * (L / (P * m i)) = 1 / P := by
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hL, ne_of_gt hP, hmi]
  rw [smul_smul, h]

theorem weighted_second_moment {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (m : ι → ℝ) (z : ι → ℂ) {L P : ℝ}
    (hL : 0 < L) (hP : 0 < P) (hm : ∀ i ∈ s, 1 ≤ m i) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, (m i / L) * ‖(L / (P * m i)) • z i‖ ^ 2 =
      (L / P ^ 2) * ∑ i ∈ s, ‖z i‖ ^ 2 / m i := by
  simp only [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, sq_abs]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  have hmi : m i ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (hm i hi))
  field_simp [ne_of_gt hL, ne_of_gt hP, hmi]
  <;> ring

theorem weighted_second_moment_le {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (m : ι → ℝ) (z : ι → ℂ) {L P : ℝ}
    (hL : 0 < L) (hP : 0 < P) (hm : ∀ i ∈ s, 1 ≤ m i) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, (m i / L) * ‖(L / (P * m i)) • z i‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (L / P ^ 2) * ∑ i ∈ s, ‖z i‖ ^ 2 := by
  rw [weighted_second_moment s m z hL hP hm]
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (div_nonneg hL.le (sq_nonneg P))
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro i hi
  exact div_le_self (sq_nonneg ‖z i‖) (hm i hi)

end ChecksumCore

claims.natural_statement: For every pair of real 2*pi-periodic C1 functions r,s with sup norms <=3,5 and derivative sup norms <=8,12, respectively, every 1<=kappa<9/8, 0<=delta<=1/32, 0<=a<=1/16, and every integer P>=2, the absolute differences between the continuous and all-finite-normalization M^2-weighted moments with exponents 8.5*(delta-u) and 8.3*(a*v-u) are at most 2^224/P; u,v are defined from the normalized tilted kernel and powered densities as in report.md Sections 1 and 3.

For the exact October rational cosine coefficients and kappa=1.0315, both continuous M^2-weighted filtering moments are strictly below 1.429584295, which is strictly below 2^0.5168; the proof accounts for rational node enclosures and analytic inner and outer quadrature errors.

For the exact October density pair and every integer P>=2^256, both all-finite-normalization filtering moments are strictly below 1.429584295+2^-32<2^0.5169; the score functions are uniformly bounded, satisfy the entropy order, and have a fixed-accuracy deterministic rational approximation procedure polynomial in log P.

For r=(0.851,0.466,0.325,0.253,0.224,-0.314), s=(1.281,-0.938,0.731,-0.559,0.391,0.110) as cosine coefficients, kappa=1.0315, eta=0.51772, tau=0.48996 and eps=10^-8, the exact block-table construction in report.md Sections 4-7 verifies October thm:checksum: for every fixed d>0, all sufficiently large n, every integer P with |log2 P-eta*n|<=2, arbitrary residues b_i modulo P and at most n^d target residues, the uniform randomized procedure retains independent uniform phases and with probability 1-o(1) returns simultaneous error <=1/8 without failure, uniformly over those inputs. Every execution costs at most 2^((tau+20*eps)*n+O(sqrt(n)))*poly(n+number_of_targets) word operations. No primality or input-distribution hypothesis is imposed.

retired_assumptions.reason: The exact unrestricted-sampling variance identity is proved in the report and recorded as C_UNIFORM_ROUTE_LIMIT; the positive filtered-estimator proof does not rely on that failed argument.
The quantifiers and all-history conclusion are explicitly restated and proved in report Sections 4-7 rather than assumed from thm:checksum. Independent source-translation review remains required.

All density coefficients and finite normalizations are now explicit definitions in the restated theorem, report Sections 1-3 and the independently replayed certificate; no numerical assertion from the source is assumed.
The exclusion of alias extraction, low-space and full-main-theorem branches is an explicit conclusion boundary, not a mathematical premise used in the checksum proof.

routes.retired_because: The exact unrestricted second moment is 2^n/N on zero residues and a nonzero target, so the routine variance bound does not supply the required high-probability additive accuracy. This does not refute the actual filtered estimator.
